item.title: Harrison Ford Brings SAG-AFTRA to Tears With Emotional Life Achievement Speech
item.description: “It's a little weird to get a lifetime achievement award at the half-point of my career,” Ford joked from the Actor Awards stage, before giving a heartfelt address that visibly moved a crowd of his peers.

item.title: Actor Awards 2026 Winners: See the Full List Here
item.description: Sinners won big at the Actor Awards 2026 (formerly the SAG Awards)—suggesting the Academy Awards race is alive, well, and ongoing.

item.title: Quiet, Please: Words, Phrases and Slang We'd Like to Ban
item.description: Gather ’round the watercooler, we’re talking about verbal tics that have outlived their moment. Cher is iconic; your bachelorette party was not. You ate your lunch, not your annual review. While “fetch” never happened, these expressions did—and now it’s time to file them far, far away.

item.title: From Psilocybin to Ozempic: The Vanity Fair Guide to Microdosing
item.description: Want to do drugs but not so many drugs that you’re speaking in tongues during your 10 a.m. Zoom? Try microdosing. We’re not saying you should take any of these (our lawyers want us to make that very clear), but if you do, here’s our guide to the mostly illicit scene.

item.title: See What the Oscars 2026 Nominees Wore to Their First Academy Awards
item.description: Whether they made their Academy Awards debut in 1986, 2025, or any year in between, revisit what this year’s nominees opted for the first time they went to the Oscars.

item.title: Oscars Flashback: What Heath Ledger, Reese Witherspoon, and Meryl Streep Wore On the Oscars 2006 Red Carpet
item.description: It's hard to believe it's been 20 years since Witherspoon, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Rachel Weisz, and George Clooney hit the Oscars red carpet as first-time nominees.

item.title: How Fab 5 Freddy Introduced Debbie Harry and Chris Stein of Blondie to Rap
item.description: In an excerpt from his memoir, Everybody's Fly: A Life of Art, Music, and Changing the Culture, Fab 5 Freddy recounts how graffiti, rap music, and break dancing came together to create a cultural movement in New York, long before hip-hop went mainstream.

item.title: Cher’s Son Elijah Blue Allman Arrested After a Prep School Disturbance
item.description: The 49-year-old musician was charged with assault and trespassing at St. Paul’s School in New Hampshire.

item.title: How Quinta Brunson Finds Her Balance
item.description: At the Actor Awards 2026, the Abbott Elementary star played with her fun and serious sides in Gabriela Hearst.

item.title: See Michael B. Jordan, Kate Hudson, and Demi Moore Party After the Actor Awards 2026
item.description: Following big wins for Sinners, The Studio, and The Pitt, celebrities gathered at Milk Studios in Hollywood for post-show burgers and martinis.
